subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The fix is small and owner-local, but the exact JSON/text shape becomes agent-visible channel behavior and affects compatibility with existing command-style button actions.

options.title: Refresh linked PR around structured passthrough
options.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

options.title: Limit scope to form submissions first
options.body: Ship only `form_value` pass-through now and leave selector/input shape to a follow-up if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Decline general passthrough
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers want Feishu card actions to remain command-only and require custom plugin HTTP routes for richer forms.

recommendation.title: Refresh linked PR around structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, so they are the best available owner for the channel behavior contract.
